title: College Football
description:
Indiana at Nebraska
No. 7 Indiana visits Nebraska in a Week 6 Big Ten game. Indiana beat Rutgers, 47-15, in Week 5 for its fifth straight win, while Nebraska beat Maryland, 48-23. Josh Hoover leads Indiana, while Nebraska is paced by quarterback Anthony Colandrea.

title: College Football
